stage_assessment.finding: Catalog batch waits and ordered admission expose older artifacts to expiry. Oldest candidate198 was fetched as metadata but may expire before artifact lookup; exact failing artifact identity is unknown. Resync is an observed consequence of delivery delay, not proof that the16-publication retention policy must be enlarged or that expiry was unavoidable under prompt delivery.

Bundle fallback counter increases and snapshot-resync error is observed. Old HTTP timing list omits fallback chunk/read_state/failed requests and artifact request arguments. No absence-of-retry claim is made. The11.5s tail is one actual HTTP request, not an inferred sum of retries. Repeated body hashes can also be independent calls because SDK ingress expiry is rounded; hashes alone do not identify retries.
